resources.string: Make LumaFin your own. These steps are optional. Open a setting, then press Back to return here. You can revisit this guide in Help & Maintenance.
Optional guidance for Home layout, subtitle language and appearance, and autoplay.
Choose a layout preset, the rows you see and their order. Your current layout stays until you change it.
Find language choices and adjust how subtitles look.
Choose whether the next episode or queued item plays automatically, and review Next Up.

Choose an available subtitle language from a title’s audio/subtitle choices or the player’s subtitle menu. For your account’s default language, use Jellyfin’s user playback settings. Available tracks depend on the title.
Preview text size, color, position and brightness for subtitles drawn by LumaFin. Burned-in subtitles and external players may use their own appearance.
